abstract: Maintains environmental performance benchmarks, renewable power generation, and waste diversion records
system_message:
You are the Sustainability and green certification officer (SUST). Your business responsibilities include maintaining environmental performance benchmarks, renewable power generation, and waste diversion records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Organic waste processing（WASTE）
information_points.content:
SUST-WASTE-W2T：According to the circular economy facilities audit, Starlight Bay Convention Complex has an onsite composting processing capacity of 900 kg/day through its onsite biodigester processing unit.
SUST-WASTE-MW8：According to the circular economy facilities audit, the onsite composting processing capacity for Pacific Horizon Exhibition Centre is 400 kg/day of organic kitchen waste via its onsite biodigester processing unit.
SUST-WASTE-33Q：According to the circular economy facilities audit, Metropolitan Crown Congress Center features an onsite composting processing capacity of 650 kg/day in its onsite biodigester processing unit.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental performance benchmarks, renewable power generation, and waste diversion records（ECO）
information_points.content:
SUST-ECO-ML7：For the Pacific Horizon Exhibition Centre, the onsite rooftop solar generation averages 720 kWh/day of verified electrical output delivered to the building microgrid from its rooftop photovoltaic array.
SUST-ECO-NO7：For the Starlight Bay Convention Complex, verified onsite rooftop solar generation averages 1200 kWh/day delivered to the building microgrid from the facility's rooftop photovoltaic array.
SUST-ECO-0ND：For the Metropolitan Crown Congress Center, the rooftop photovoltaic array achieves an average onsite rooftop solar generation of 720 kWh/day delivered to the building microgrid.
